stem_block:
GROWING FOOD IN CITIES

Background
• 19th-century laws forced councils to supply (31) ........ to households without a garden
• the number of plots then dropped for half a century

Three forms today
• the (32) ........ — much the commonest, on ground nobody else has a use for
• a farm on the flat roof of an existing building
• an indoor farm lit by lamps

What the survey found
• a typical shared garden covers roughly (33) ........ square metres
• a realistic yield is about (34) ........ times that of a field, and only for salad and soft fruit

What it does for the city
• a planted roof held back about (35) ........ of one heavy downpour
• what gardeners mentioned most was (36) ........ with other people, not the food

items.prompt: 19th-century laws forced councils to supply (31) ........ to households without a garden
items.evidence: a series of Acts obliged local authorities to provide allotments
items.explanation: On dokuzuncu yüzyıl yasaları belediyeleri, bahçesi olmayan hanelere kiralık küçük parseller (allotment) vermeye zorlamış.

items.prompt: the (32) ........ — much the commonest, on ground nobody else has a use for
items.evidence: The first, and by far the most common, is the community garden
items.explanation: Üç biçimden açık ara en yaygını, başka bir işlevi olmayan arazide kurulan ortak bahçe.

items.prompt: a typical shared garden covers roughly (33) ........ square metres
items.evidence: the median community garden occupied about two thousand square metres and supplied around thirty households
items.explanation: Aynı araştırma için 5.000 metrekare de aktarılıyor, ama o rakam yolları, kulübeleri ve otoparkı içeriyor; ortanca değer 2.000 metrekare.

items.prompt: a realistic yield is about (34) ........ times that of a field, and only for salad and soft fruit
items.evidence: More careful work puts the realistic figure at about three times
items.explanation: Yıllarca on beş kat verim iddia edilmiş; daha dikkatli çalışmalar gerçekçi rakamı yaklaşık üç kata çekiyor.

items.prompt: a planted roof held back about (35) ........ of one heavy downpour
items.evidence: around half of a heavy shower was retained rather than running straight into the drains
items.explanation: Bir deneme binasındaki ölçümler, şiddetli yağışın yaklaşık yarısının bitkili çatıda tutulduğunu gösteriyor.

items.prompt: what gardeners mentioned most was (36) ........ with other people, not the food
items.evidence: the benefit participants reported most often was not the food at all, but the contact with other people
items.explanation: Katılımcıların en sık andığı fayda yiyecek ya da egzersiz değil, başka insanlarla kurulan temas.
